description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableMeasurement' implementing the 'Measurement' interface. It models measurement data including metric type, success status, timestamped counts, and optional last message timestamp, with JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: ImmutableMeasurement
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Measurement interface, representing measurement data with various attributes and JSON conversion capabilities.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the metric type of the measurement.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Returns whether the measurement indicates a success.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Returns a map of durations to count values.

methods.name: getLastMessageAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last message if available.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement to a JSON object, applying a schema version and predicate filter.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Measurement object from a JSON representation.
